To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the best performance of a naive-bayers classifier for sentiment analysis on English tweets is achieved by using only two sharp polarity categories (positive and negative) and that the use of a polarity lexicon is crucial to improve the performance.

the use of a naive-bayess classifier, a polarity lexicon with multiwords, and the application of a very simple rule that searches for polarity words within a text, are key factors in the success of a strategy for detecting the polarity (positive/negative) of tweets.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of an algorithm for the automatic classification of English tweets based on a naive bayes classifier and with the analysis of the performance of the algorithm when it is applied to a corpus of English tweets.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the system described in this work is not able to achieve a good performance on the detection of polarity in tweets.
the system is able to detect tweets with a positive or negative polarity with a good precision.
this system is able to detect the polarity of a tweet with 63% F-measure, but it is not able to distinguish between positive, negative, or neutral tweets.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of a naive-bayess classifier with a polarity lexicons and multiword is a very simple and effective strategy for sentiment analysis.
we have developed a strategy that is based on a naive bayes classifier for sentiment analysis on tweets.

a naive-bayess classifier can be used to detect the sentiment of English tweets, and that the best performance was achieved with a binary classifier that uses a polarity lexicon, a multiword lexicon, and a rule that searches for polarity words in the tweets.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a very simple approach can achieve a good performance in the sentiment classification of tweets, even when the polarity lexicon and the multiwords are not so big.
the best performance of the classifier is achieved when it is provided with a small number of features.
the best results are achieved by using a simple strategy that does not require any kind of preprocessing of the tweets.
